assertions.evidence: transcript read SKILL.md, references/decision-model-limits.md, references/decisions-api.md, references/models.md

In src/lead-routing.ts, routeLead returns "Enterprise" when `lead.headcount > ENTERPRISE_HEADCOUNT` or `distinctRegions.size >= ENTERPRISE_REGIONS`, and it does so before `call(rolloutRequest(text), ...)`; the tests use a `noCall` stub that throws to confirm the model is skipped.
src/decisions.ts POSTs to `https://openrouter.ai/api/alpha/decisions`, and rolloutRequest sets `model: JEV_MODEL`, which is `typesafe/jev-1.13-20260917`, a dated build ID rather than the alias.
rolloutRequest sends `state: { whatAreYouLookingFor: text }` only, and the test asserts `request.state` deepEquals `{ whatAreYouLookingFor: lead.whatAreYouLookingFor }`.
